<<Notes on Mending Of Fishing Nets>>  
Fishing nets are essential for the livelihood of many communities, but they often become damaged during fishing. To ensure sustainability, the community is encouraged to participate in net mending efforts. This not only helps in recovering usable nets but also reduces waste and promotes resource efficiency. Local volunteers and fishermen work together to repair nets, using available materials and techniques. The initiative fosters teamwork and environmental responsibility, ensuring that fishing remains a sustainable practice for future generations. Let’s come together to preserve our marine resources and support our community’s continued success.
